rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for saying that an action happens in no place or goes to no place.

example.english: I eat nowhere but at home.
example.traditional: 我邊度都唔食飯，淨係喺屋企食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bin1 dou6 dou1 m4 sik6 faan6 zing6 hai6 hai2 uk1 kei2 sik6

rows.jyutping: bin1 dou6 dou1 heoi3 m4 dou2
rows.note: Use this when going nowhere emphasizes being unable to reach any destination or making no progress.

example.english: I can get nowhere because the car has broken down.
example.traditional: 我邊度都去唔到，架車壞咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bin1 dou6 dou1 heoi3 m4 dou2 gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2
